sloka: विधवा हतपुत्राश्च क्रोशन्त्यो हतबान्धवाः।राक्षस्यः सह सङ्गम्य दुःखार्ताः पर्यदेवयन् ।। ६.९५.५ ।।
transliteration: vidhavā hataputrāśca krośantyo hatabāndhavāḥ।rākṣasyaḥ saha saṅgamya duḥkhārtāḥ paryadevayan ।। 6.95.5 ।।

translations.english: "On seeing and hearing of the others left over, the night rangers felt bewildered and piteous with agony coming together, moving in groups, those who lost husband, son, kin and protectors along with associates crying, stricken with grief."
